## Problem

Describe the concrete problem this change resolves.

## Changes

Describe the smallest coherent implementation.

## Evidence

- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] `bun run check` passes.
- [ ] Visible changes include screenshots or equivalent evidence.
- [ ] Research changes identify supporting sources and evidence boundaries.
- [ ] No credentials, private analytics, personal health information, or local paths are included.

## Research boundary

For research changes, state what is direct evidence, mechanism, inference, history, or experience. Write “Not applicable” for nonresearch changes.
